segments.text: Lesson 46
segments.translation: 第46课

segments.text: Hobbies
segments.translation: 爱好

segments.text: Listen to the tape then answer this question.
segments.translation: 听录音，然后回答问题。

segments.text: Who, according to the author, are 'Fortune's favoured children'?
segments.translation: 根据作者所说，谁是命运的宠儿？

segments.text: A gifted American psychologist has said, 'Worry is a spasm of the emotion;
segments.translation: 一位有天赋的美国心理学家说过，忧虑是情感的痉挛；

segments.text: the mind catches hold of something and will not let it go.'
segments.translation: 心灵抓住某件事不放。

segments.text: It is useless to argue with the mind in this condition.
segments.translation: 在这种状态下与心灵争论是无用的。

segments.text: The stronger the will, the more futile the task.
segments.translation: 意志越强，任务就越徒劳。

segments.text: One can only gently insinuate something else into its convulsive grasp.
segments.translation: 只能轻轻地将别的东西悄悄塞进它痉挛般的紧握中。

segments.text: And if this something else is rightly chosen, if it is really attended by the illumination of another field of interest,
segments.translation: 如果这个别的东西选择得当，如果它确实被另一个兴趣领域的光芒所照耀，

segments.text: gradually, and often quite swiftly, the old undue grip relaxes and the process of recuperation and repair begins.
segments.translation: 逐渐地，而且往往相当迅速地，旧日过度的掌控就会放松，恢复和修复的过程就开始了。

segments.text: The cultivation of a hobby and new forms of interest is therefore a policy of the first importance to a public man.
segments.translation: 因此，培养一种爱好和新的兴趣形式对公众人物来说是头等重要的策略。

segments.text: But this is not a business that can be undertaken in a day or swiftly improvised by a mere command of the will.
segments.translation: 但这不是一天就能完成的事业，也不是仅凭意志的命令就能迅速即兴安排的。

segments.text: The growth of alternative mental interests is a long process.
segments.translation: 替代性精神兴趣的增长是一个漫长的过程。

segments.text: The seeds must be carefully chosen; they must fall on good ground;
segments.translation: 种子必须精心挑选；它们必须落在好土地上；

segments.text: they must be sedulously tended, if the vivifying fruits are to be at hand when needed.
segments.translation: 如果需要时想要有令人振奋的果实，就必须勤勉地照料它们。

segments.text: To be really happy and really safe, one ought to have at least two or three hobbies, and they must all be real.
segments.translation: 要真正快乐和真正安全，一个人应该至少有两三个爱好，而且它们必须都是真实的。

segments.text: It is no use starting late in life to say: 'I will take an interest in this or that.'
segments.translation: 晚年才开始说我要对这个或那个感兴趣是没有用的。

segments.text: Such an attempt only aggravates the strain of mental effort.
segments.translation: 这样的尝试只会加剧精神努力的紧张。

segments.text: A man may acquire great knowledge of topics unconnected with his daily work, and yet get hardly any benefit or relief.
segments.translation: 一个人可能获得与日常工作无关话题的渊博知识，却几乎得不到任何好处或解脱。

segments.text: It is no use doing what you like; you have got to like what you do.
segments.translation: 做你喜欢的事是没有用的；你必须喜欢你所做的事。

segments.text: Broadly speaking, human beings may be divided into three classes:
segments.translation: 广义地说，人类可分为三类：

segments.text: those who are toiled to death, those who are worried to death, and those who are bored to death.
segments.translation: 那些劳累致死的人、那些忧虑致死的人、和那些无聊致死的人。

segments.text: It is no use offering the manual labourer,
segments.translation: 向体力劳动者提供

segments.text: tired out with a hard week's sweat and effort the chance of playing a game of football or baseball on Saturday afternoon.
segments.translation: 在一周辛苦的汗水和努力之后，周六下午踢足球或打棒球的机会是没有用的。

segments.text: It is no use inviting the politician or the professional or business man, who has been working or worrying about serious things for six days,
segments.translation: 邀请那些已经为严肃事务工作或忧虑了六天的政治家、专业人士或商人

segments.text: to work or worry about trifling things at the weekend.
segments.translation: 在周末去工作或忧虑琐事是没有用的。

segments.text: As for the unfortunate people who can command everything they want,
segments.translation: 至于那些不幸能掌控一切的人，

segments.text: who can gratify every caprice and lay their hands on almost every object of desire--for them a new pleasure a new excitement is only an additional satiation.
segments.translation: 能满足每一个任性、几乎能拿到每一个欲望之物的人，对他们来说，新的快乐、新的刺激只是额外的满足。

segments.text: In vain they rush frantically round from place to place, trying to escape from avenging boredom by mere clatter and motion.
segments.translation: 他们徒劳地疯狂地从一个地方冲到另一个地方，试图通过喧闹和运动来逃避报复性的无聊。

segments.text: For them discipline in one form or another is the most hopeful path.
segments.translation: 对他们来说，某种形式的纪律是最有希望的道路。

segments.text: It may also be said that rational, industrious, useful human beings are divided into two classes:
segments.translation: 也可以说，理性、勤奋、有用的人类分为两类：

segments.text: first, those whose work is work and whose pleasure is pleasure;
segments.translation: 第一，那些工作是工作、乐趣是乐趣的人；

segments.text: and secondly, those whose work and pleasure are one.
segments.translation: 第二，那些工作和乐趣合而为一的人。

segments.text: Of these the former are the majority. They have their compensations.
segments.translation: 其中前者是多数。他们有自己的补偿。

segments.text: The long hours in the office or the factory bring with them as their reward,
segments.translation: 在办公室或工厂的长时间工作带来的回报，

segments.text: not only the means of sustenance, but a keen appetite for pleasure even in its simplest and most modest forms.
segments.translation: 不仅是生计手段，还有对最简单最朴素形式乐趣的强烈渴望。

segments.text: But Fortune's favoured children belong to the second class.
segments.translation: 但命运的宠儿属于第二类。

segments.text: Their life is a natural harmony.
segments.translation: 他们的生活是一种自然的和谐。

segments.text: For them the working hours are never long enough.
segments.translation: 对他们来说，工作时间永远不够长。

segments.text: Each day is a holiday, and ordinary holidays, when they come, are grudged as enforced interruptions in an absorbing vocation.
segments.translation: 每一天都是假日，普通的假日来临时，反而被视为引人入胜的职业中的强制中断。

segments.text: Yet to both classes, the need of an alternative outlook, of a change of atmosphere of a diversion of effort, is essential.
segments.translation: 然而，对这两个阶层来说，需要一种替代的视角、一种气氛的改变、一种努力的转移，是至关重要的。

segments.text: Indeed, it may well be that those whose work is their pleasure are those who most need the means of banishing it at intervals from their minds.
segments.translation: 确实，那些工作即乐趣的人很可能最需要不时将它从脑海中驱除的方法。
